title: NORMVIZ: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models on NORMVIZ-BENCH, a dataset of contrastive image pairs spanning 16 countries, to measure their ability to correctly classify visually observable behaviors as conforming to, violating, or being irrelevant to specific local cultural norms using a group accuracy metric.
